ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 7 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 8
   C. 7
   D. 7

2. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

3. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 1
   C. 12
   D. 7

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 19
   C. 7
   D. 17

5. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 26

6. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 72
   C. 1
   D. 17

7. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 14

8. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

10. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 4

11. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 36

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
